disabled.description: Keep the row discoverable by keyboard while preventing user activation.

expanded.description: Whether a branch reveals its children. Has no visible effect on a leaf.

href.description: Native destination of the row. Prefer selection="none" for navigation trees.

icon-name.description: Optional decorative icon. Import the named Kimen glyph before mounting the tree.

lazy.description: Request children on the first empty expansion. Clear it to finish an empty load.

loading-label.description: Localized text for the spinner status during an outstanding lazy request.

selected.description: Selected state. The tree keeps it in sync with single selection or fully checked branches.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-tree-edge-width.description: Width of the surface and checkbox outlines.

--ki-tree-focus-ring-color.description: Ink of the focused row outline.

--ki-tree-focus-ring-width.description: Width of the focused row outline.

--ki-tree-hover-bg.description: Fill of an unselected row hovered by a fine pointer.

--ki-tree-hover-fg.description: Text of an unselected row hovered by a fine pointer.

--ki-tree-icon-fg.description: Default ink of the decorative row icons.

--ki-tree-item-box-radius.description: Rounding of the visual checkbox indicator.

--ki-tree-item-box-size.description: Size of the visual checkbox indicator.

--ki-tree-item-gap.description: Space between an optional item icon and its label.

--ki-tree-item-padding.description: Inline-end inset of an item row.

--ki-tree-item-radius.description: Rounding of a highlighted item row.

--ki-tree-item-target.description: Minimum inline target of a disclosure or checkbox.

--ki-tree-row-height.description: Minimum block size before density adjustment.

--ki-tree-selected-bg.description: Fill of a selected or checked row.

--ki-tree-selected-fg.description: Text and glyph ink on a selected row.

--ki-tree-touch-row-min.description: Minimum row block size on a coarse pointer.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: An item or expandable branch inside a ki-tree.

ki-collapse.description: Emitted when an existing branch collapses.

ki-expand.description: Emitted when an existing branch expands.

ki-load.description: Emitted once when an empty lazy branch first opens. The listener supplies the children.

checkbox.description: Check-state indicator and hit area in multiple selection.

disclosure.description: Leading hit area and direction indicator of a branch.

group.description: The region containing the expanded child items.

label.description: Visible row text or native destination link.

row.description: The painted and focus-highlighted item row.

disabled.description: Keep the row discoverable by keyboard while preventing user activation.

expanded.description: Whether a branch reveals its children. Has no visible effect on a leaf.

href.description: Native destination of the row. Prefer selection="none" for navigation trees.

iconName.description: Optional decorative icon. Import the named Kimen glyph before mounting the tree.

lazy.description: Request children on the first empty expansion. Clear it to finish an empty load.

loadingLabel.description: Localized text for the spinner status during an outstanding lazy request.

selected.description: Selected state. The tree keeps it in sync with single selection or fully checked branches.

slots.description: The row label and directly nested ki-tree-item children.
